news.title: Football Legends and the Power of World Cup Nostalgia
news.lede: The 2026 World Cup has come to an end, and there is good reason people are talking about what a success it was. Revenues are estimated to be between USD 13.5 billion and USD 15 billion for the entire 2023–2026 cycle, surpassing the USD 11 billion expectation for this period. Another of the hottest talking points was the “Americanization” of the tournament featuring the “4 quarters” due to controversial hydration breaks, the halftime show at the final, and shots of celebrities in the stands during the broadcast, all typical of U.S. sports. news.title: Egypt coach Hossam Hassan extends contract until 2030
news.lede: REUTERS REUTERS https://ss-i.thgim.com/public/incoming/yq64h6/article71416798.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/2026-06-22T031900Z_1800468031_UP1EM6M097MYN_RTRMADP_3_SOCCER-WORLDCUP-NZL-EGY.JPG LEE SMITH Soccer Football - FIFA World Cup 2026 - Group G - New Zealand v Egypt - BC Place, Vancouver, Canada - June 21, 2026 Egypt coach Hossam Hassan runs onto the pitch waving their national flag after the match REUTERS/Lee Smith The 60-year-old has been handed a new deal after guiding Egypt to the 2026 World Cup round of 16 and the semifinals of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations. CHENNAI Egypt head coach Hossam Hassan has extended his contract with the national team until 2030, the Egyptian Football Association announced on Tuesday. The 60-year-old, who took charge in 2024, has overseen a period of improved results for Egypt, including a run to the round of 16 at the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

news.title: No more Messi nights for Argentina as skipper says adios to national squad
news.lede: Fifa president Gianni Infantino led the tributes to Argentina skipper Lionel Messi, who announced his retirement from international football just over a month after playing in the 2026 World Cup final. "Thank you for bringing so much joy to millions of football fans," said Infantino, who handed Messi a runners-up medal following his side's 1-0 defeat to Spain on 19 July at the MetLife Stadium in New Jersey. "You are retiring from international football as one of the greatest players our sport has ever seen. I wish you all the best."
